# Stone & Rose Landscaping

> Arizona landscape design studio based in the Phoenix metro area. Designs backyards, pools, outdoor kitchens, front yards, lighting and desert planting in photorealistic 3D, and prepares HOA submittal packages, spec sheets and measured build plans for homeowners and for landscape and pool contractors.

- Phone: (480) 973-5166 (call or text)
- Email: Stoneandrose@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/stoneandrose
- Service area: Phoenix metropolitan area, Arizona

## Pages

- [Home: landscape design for homeowners](https://www.YOURDOMAIN.com/): services, 3D portfolio, process, FAQ, project inquiry form
- [For contractors](https://www.YOURDOMAIN.com/contractors.html): 3D renderings, HOA submittals, spec sheets and measured build plans for Arizona contractors; referral partnership

## Services

- Full backyard design in 3D
- Pool and water feature design
- Outdoor kitchen and entertaining areas
- Front yard and desert landscape design
- Landscape lighting and planting plans
- HOA submittal packages
- Design-only packages for homeowners who already have a contractor
- Design support for contractors (renders, submittals, spec sheets, build plans)
